what: Hugging Face's 24 agent skills: llm-trainer (TRL SFT/DPO/GRPO/reward, Unsloth, GGUF, Hub push), trackio, hf-cli, jobs.
problem_here: Harness only names TRL/PEFT/Unsloth as optional modules; no vetted per-method scripts or data-format rules.
mechanism: Skill plus template training scripts and reference files (training_methods, hardware_guide, gguf_conversion, reliability_principles) executed through HF Jobs.
evidence: github.com/huggingface/skills commit 25910b3, 2026-10-29; 11.3k stars; Apache-2.0; no published results or tests found.
cost: Free; HF Jobs usage costs money and needs an account.
simpler_alternative: Copy the reference files' recipes into the harness's own fine-tuning reference.
reason: Used together with the harness, not as a replacement: it has no guard, evaluator protection or statistics. Cannot replace any part of the harness.
cheap_local_trial: Run the llm-trainer templates on a tiny model under the harness controller and guard hook; check the guard does not block its scripts and that metrics land in the run directory.

candidate: Pre-launch smoke test on a tiny setting
what: Before any long or paid run, launch the real job for a couple of steps and report whether it used the GPU.
problem_here: Brief lists no smoke-test stage; a failed paid run costs money and time.
mechanism: Stage in the skill: tiny config run via the controller, check metrics file written, then full run.
evidence: W&B wandb-autoresearch search.md (commit 10aac21, 2026-11-06) requires it; HF trainer skill advises small demo sizes. No measured benefit found.
reason: Already the kit's procedure: SKILL.md gate 1 asks for a smoke run through `expctl launch` on a tiny budget before any long run, and hpo.md for a feasibility probe of a few steps before a full trial. A step of the procedure, not enforced by code.
cheap_local_trial: Add the stage to the skill, count smoke-test failures over the next campaigns.

what: Forecast cost of a remote job from hardware, duration and price before launching.
problem_here: Harness cap stops spending after the fact; it does not forecast.
mechanism: Small script multiplying flavor price by expected hours, shown to the user before submit.
evidence: HF huggingface-llm-trainer SKILL.md mentions scripts/estimate_cost.py (commit 25910b3); script source not opened.
simpler_alternative: Static price table in a config file the user edits.
reason: The cost of a paid launch is already fixed before it starts: `nnremote` books the hours the user allows times the target's price against the cap and refuses when the cap does not cover it. What the kit lacks is an estimate of the hours. Prices change and need the network; cap already limits loss.
cheap_local_trial: Compare a static-table estimate with actual HF Jobs bills on three runs.

what: SkyPilot's skill for launching clusters and managed jobs across clouds with spot recovery and autostop.
problem_here: Harness remote support is SSH and HF Jobs only.
mechanism: Agent generates task YAML and runs sky launch / sky jobs launch; cluster autostop and --down.
evidence: docs.skypilot.ai autoresearch example (undated): 16 GPUs, 8 h, about 910 experiments, val_bpb 1.003 to 0.974, about $300 GPU + $9 API. Repo master commit 2026-11-11.
cost: Cloud compute money; needs cloud credentials and the sky CLI.
simpler_alternative: Existing SSH backend to a rented machine.
reason: Its cost guards are prompt text, and it lets the agent start paid resources past the kit's controller and cap (stack.md, 'Not recommended'). The published speed-up, the same loss about nine times sooner on 16 GPUs, is a single run.
cheap_local_trial: Run one SkyPilot job behind the harness spending cap on the cheapest GPU; check the cap sees the cost and teardown works.

what: W&B skills: wandb-primary, wandb-autoresearch (bounded serial search via Launch), eval tables, Weave tracing.
problem_here: Harness tracking is a local metrics file; no hosted dashboards or reports.
mechanism: Skills plus helper scripts using the wandb SDK and Launch queues.
evidence: github.com/wandb/skills commit 10aac21, 2026-11-06; Skill Bench: model training 90% Claude Code / 85% Codex on 8 tasks, +-3%; vendor-run.
simpler_alternative: Trackio (already an optional module) or the local metrics file.
reason: Needs a Weights & Biases account, which the user has not set up; its sweep loop has no fixed evaluator and no sealed data, and asks for one rerun of the winner by prompt. Reversal: the user adopts W&B as the tracker.
cheap_local_trial: Mirror one harness run into W&B and see whether the agent can read it through the skill.

what: Fast LoRA/QLoRA/full/GRPO/DPO fine-tuning, GGUF export, Studio UI, and unsloth start <agent>.
problem_here: Harness names Unsloth as optional; fine-tuning speed and VRAM matter on small GPUs.
mechanism: Python library plus app; agents can use its local models.
evidence: Release v0.1.917-beta 2026-11-11; 79.3k stars; Apache-2.0 core, AGPL Studio; claims 2x faster, 70% less VRAM are vendor claims.
cost: Free; AGPL for the UI if redistributed.
reason: Used as a training library inside harness runs, not as a controller; no guard, no sealed data.
cheap_local_trial: Fine-tune one small model with Unsloth and with PEFT+TRL under the harness, same seeds, compare tokens per second and peak VRAM.

what: Reference minimal keep-or-revert loop: edit train.py, 5-minute run, val_bpb, git commit or reset.
problem_here: Harness has this loop already; question is whether to replace it.
mechanism: Instructions in program.md and a read-only prepare.py.
evidence: github.com/karpathy/autoresearch commit 228791f, 2026-03-26; 99.8k stars; MIT; about 700 changes with about 20 kept (third-party blog, not opened at source).
maturity: Stale for 7.5 months; one GPU, NVIDIA only.
reason: As a whole: the agent reads its own log, runs single seeds, and nothing is hidden or checksummed. Its pattern is what the kit's loop took (coverage map, Gap 1). No commit since 26 Mar 2026.

what: General modify-verify-keep/discard skill with guard command, hooks, regression stats, fork-and-flush.
problem_here: Harness loop may stall on plateaus; no restart strategy named.
mechanism: Skill commands; Mann-Whitney U in regression; forks fresh-context branches at 33% and 66% of budget.
evidence: Repo v2.3.0 commit 7bddd05, 2026-10-31; 6.8k stars; MIT; author claims only; commit says cross-platform matrix not tested.
simpler_alternative: Existing loop plus a manual restart from the best commit.
reason: As a whole: it keeps or reverts on the number of a command the agent itself runs, has no sealed data and works with Claude Code only. Its restart on a plateau is the branch-on-stall row.

what: After N non-keeps, restart a fresh-context branch from the best committed state.
problem_here: Unattended loop may stall in one context.
mechanism: Branch from best, empty context, continue.
evidence: UG README cites two arXiv papers (not opened); no numbers seen.
cheap_local_trial: Replay a stalled campaign journal with and without the restart and compare keeps.

what: Official Optuna MCP: study, ask/tell, plots, dashboard, SQLite storage.
problem_here: Harness has Optuna as an optional module with no agent-facing tool.
mechanism: MCP tools; sampler set by name.
evidence: github.com/optuna/optuna-mcp commit 2026-10-22; 91 stars; MIT; pruners not documented on the page.
simpler_alternative: Plain Optuna in the training script.
reason: The harness, not the agent, reports results: a server through which the agent calls `tell` puts the agent in charge of the objective values (stack.md, 'Not recommended'). The repository is active (a commit of 22 Oct 2026, latest tag v0.2.0), so the earlier reason 'stale' no longer holds.
cheap_local_trial: Drive three trials through ask/tell with the harness launching each run.

what: Official experimental MLflow MCP (mlflow mcp run, MLflow 3.5.1+).
evidence: mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/mcp: documented tools are trace and assessment operations; no run metrics tools listed.
reason: Documented tools do not cover run metrics.

candidate: Agent Skills distribution (npx skills, plugin marketplace)
what: Publish the harness skill so it installs by npx skills add and plugin marketplaces.
problem_here: Own installer reaches only three agents.
mechanism: Skill folder with SKILL.md in the common format.
evidence: HF, W&B, SkyPilot and UG all install this way (their READMEs, Nov 2026).
cost: Packaging effort; hooks and subagents do not travel in a bare skill.
reason: The guard hook is what matters and a bare skill drops it.
cheap_local_trial: Check the skill folder loads in Codex via npx skills without the installer.

what: Per-agent pass-rate benchmark of the skill on fixed tasks.
problem_here: Cannot show the skill helps beyond own tests (?).
mechanism: Task set run by each agent, pass rate with interval.
evidence: W&B Skill Bench in wandb/skills README, +-3%; vendor-run.
cheap_local_trial: Write five scripted tasks and run them once with a cheap model.

candidate: GGUF export via HF gguf_conversion reference
what: Convert and quantize fine-tuned models for llama.cpp and Ollama.
problem_here: Export step only named, not done.
evidence: HF skill gguf_conversion.md (commit 25910b3); Unsloth Studio export page; no quality numbers read.
cheap_local_trial: Convert one tiny model and compare outputs before and after quantization.

what: 98 reference skills (Axolotl, LLaMA-Factory, PEFT, Unsloth, TRL, lm-eval-harness, W&B, MLflow).
evidence: README at commit 773a529 (v1.7.2), 2026-06-16; about 11k stars; MIT; its README tells the reader's agent to fetch and follow a remote welcome.md.
reason: Stale, and a README that tells the agent to follow remote instructions is a hazard.

evidence: Repo archived 2026-10-22 and moved to HuggingChat; 10.8k stars.
reason: Archived and not a skill for an existing agent.

what: Loop plugin with PreToolUse hook protecting prepare.py, MAD confidence, 27 end-to-end tests.
evidence: GitHub page: 12 stars, 32 commits, no releases or dates.
reason: Too small; ideas already present in the harness.
